{{Quote|There's no need to apologize. You saved my life, you know.|Bant to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Captive Temple">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Captive Temple]]''</ref>}}
'''Bant Eerin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Eerin was a contemporary and a childhood friend of Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
As a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], Bant Eerin was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. A contemporary of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Darsha Assant]],<ref name="Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> [[Reeft]], and [[Garen Muln]], Eerin excelled in her classes at the [[Jedi academy|Temple academy]], though she often took breaks throughout the day to visit the [[Room of a Thousand Fountains/Legends|Room of a Thousand Fountains]]. Due to her aquatic nature, her [[Jedi Temple dormitory|dormitory]] was filled with moisture to keep her skin moist and cool.<ref name="The Uncertain Path">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Uncertain Path]]''</ref> Though two years younger than him, Eerin was a close confidant of Kenobi's. She attempted to console him when he was at first assigned to the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]], then welcomed him back to the Temple after [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] accepted Kenobi as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="ja1p" />

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], when Kenobi briefly left the Order during the [[Melida/Daan Civil War]], Eerin blamed Master Jinn for abandoning her friend to [[the Young]]. However, she was asked to aid Masters Jinn and [[Tahl]] during this time as a [[Incident at the Jedi Temple|series of robberies]] began plaguing the Temple. When the stolen items were discovered at the bottom of the pool of water on the [[Lake level|Lake Level]] of the Temple, Jinn asked Eerin to dive down and bring up the crates, due to her ability to hold her breath for extended periods of time. After recovering the objects, Eerin was kidnapped by fellow apprentice [[Bruck Chun]], who had been swayed to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] by the mastermind behind the attacks on the Temple, [[Xanatos]]. Discovering that she was gone, the Jedi began searching for her; a returning Kenobi found and rescued her from the bottom of the waterfall pool in the Room of a Thousand Fountains before she drowned.<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Captive Temple" />

Following this ordeal at the Temple, Master Tahl chose to take Eerin as her Padawan,<ref name="The Ties That Bind" /> convinced by her bravery and her resourcefulness that they were a good pairing. While Tahl respected Eerin's heart and skill, she feared she was too young for some of the more challenging missions she was assigned, and often left her at the Temple. Eerin began to feel neglected as a Padawan,<ref name="The Ties That Bind" /> and her self-doubt was made far worse when Tahl was killed on an assignment to [[New Apsolon/Legends|New Apsolon]]. She had blamed Obi-Wan Kenobi for Tahl's death by not contacting the Temple after her capture. However, her anger had diminished in time as they worked together to track down [[Balog (Human)|Balog]].<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Call to Vengeance">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Call to Vengeance]]''</ref>

Orphaned, Eerin remained at the Temple in mourning for her dead master, until she was approached by the quiet and reflective Master [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]. Fisto offered to continue the girl's training and she accepted.<ref name="POTJ" /> During their time together, the pair discovered disturbing evidence of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] cultists practicing on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Contacting the Temple immediately from the ruined world, the pair's discovery led to the eventual incarceration of Sith supporter [[Murk Lundi]].<ref name="Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers">''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers]]''</ref>

===Jedi Knighthood===
Eventually, like most of her friends, Eerin faced her [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] and was elevated to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. While her duties took her far away from her friends, she maintained contact with Kenobi by exchanging small gifts they would leave at the Temple. Eerin and Kenobi met in [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]] after a three [[Standard year/Legends|year]] separation when the former joined [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and Garen Muln in rescuing Kenobi from the armies of [[Roy Teda]] on the planet [[Romin]].<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard">''[[Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard]]''</ref> About four years after this encounter, Eerin would aid in the rescue of Kenobi again. Responding to Master Windu's summons, Eerin joined a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] to rescue Kenobi, his Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] from execution by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Piloting a [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light starfighter]] to the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], she flew alongside Master [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]] in a massive [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|space battle]] that ensured the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] could land safely on the planet to extract the captives.<ref name="JSF" />

After the opening battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Eerin reported back to Coruscant where she took up the mantle of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] within the ranks of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] as well as the title of Master. When the High Council decided to increase the number of Padawans being trained, Eerin selected an [[Bant Eerin's Padawan|apprentice]] from the Temple's academy. Together with her student, Eerin tracked the CIS [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Bitt Panith]] to the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]]. Crafting an offensive military operation that would take place on three fronts, Eerin dispatched her student to [[Akoshissss]] to negotiate with the local [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] while she pursued Panith. Accompanied by the [[Eighteenth Battalion]], Eerin and her troops were victorious in [[Battle of Akoshissss|battle]], capturing Panith and fending off the [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="The Way of the Jedi" />

===Legacy===
The Clone Wars concluded in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] due to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] issuance of [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to the Grand Army, effectively outlawing the Jedi Order and commanding the execution of all Jedi. While records regarding Eerin's fate were lost, her old friend, Master Kenobi reflected on her death during his exile on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission">''[[The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission]]''</ref>
